def: A language model that conditions on text retrieved from an external datastore, whether retrieval is built in during pretraining (REALM, RETRO), added by fine-tuning (RA-DIT) or used only at inference.
practice: The research umbrella over RAG; In-Context RALM (Ram et al., 2023) showed that prepending retrieved documents to a frozen model's input brings large gains, which is how most production RAG works.
